variant: bare=true; className "w-full text-[14px]"; ref inputRef; value bound to q
purpose: Filter query for the command list. It is focused automatically on open.
text: Placeholder "Run a command or jump to…" (single ellipsis character). Typed values in reference states: "" (palette), "new" (palette-search), "zzzz" (palette-no-match).
behaviour: Typing sets q and resets the active row to 0. The list is filtered by case-insensitive substring match on the label (not fuzzy) and ranked by match index, earlier matches first, stable. ArrowDown moves active down, capped at results.length-1; with zero results it becomes -1 and nothing is highlighted. ArrowUp moves active up, floored at 0. Enter runs the active row; the default key is prevented for these keys. Enter with no results does nothing.
